## Verdict

{Script-owned. One row per criterion of the RESEARCH-PLAN, in the plan's order, exactly the plan's rows (graph_gate G7 compares the row IDs with the plan's Success Criteria). Mechanical rows measured from the compiler's output; the judged row copied from the CONJECTURE's `Confirmed faithful by` line. Status `pass` (or `refuted` for a refutation) requires every row `pass`; otherwise `incomplete`; `error` when the attestation started but could not complete.}

| Criterion ID | Measured | Threshold | Measured by | Result |
|--------------|----------|-----------|-------------|--------|
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-builds` | {exit code, errors} | exit 0, 0 errors | mechanical: lake build | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-sorry-free` | {sorryAx in closure: yes / no} | absent | mechanical: #print axioms | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-axioms-standard` | {axiom list} | ⊆ allowed set | mechanical: #print axioms | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-statement-matches` | {equal / differs} | equal up to whitespace | mechanical: #check vs CONJECTURE | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-dependencies-pinned` | {toolchain, packages} | all pinned | mechanical: lean-toolchain + lake-manifest.json | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-statement-confirmed` | {Faithfulness Cross-Check: read by, discrepancies, instances, confirmed by} | complete, no open discrepancy | judged by: {reader} + {confirmer} (CONJECTURE Faithfulness Cross-Check) | pass / fail |
| `cpt-{system}-criterion-{slug}` | {route-specific row declared in the plan, e.g. a passing CHECK-RUN for tier A} | {…} | {mechanical: … / judged by: {person}} | pass / fail |
